utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus—that’s really kind of you. I’ll keep it simple and let Leo know we’ve got the tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll check what’s left and make a quick list of the essentials.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got left for the repair drive and make a quick list. Tell me what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve just heard folks are still gathering donations and sorting the repair priorities, so a quick list would really help. I can pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what’s the easiest way for me to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — maybe the easiest thing is to help after school hours so we avoid pickup traffic and parking hassles. If you can, just let me know what times work best for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m ready to take on the first task for the repair drive—what would help most right now?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I’m still in, and I’ll keep it low-key. Let me know what specific help you need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still happening — I’m here to help keep track of the locations. Where should we start?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi — yes, I’m still on for the repair drive. What time were you thinking this weekend so I can work around the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a bit, but I’d rather keep it low-key. Sunday morning would work best for me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Dane — I’d be grateful for any behind-the-scenes help you can give. I’m trying to keep the repair drive moving, and I may need a hand remembering the next step.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I’m here—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—let’s set a clear time for the repair drive and keep to it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll help keep it organized and make sure everyone knows the time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I can lend a hand and any tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still happening. Thanks, Gus—I’ll keep it simple and let you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Rey—our repair drive moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center. Let’s start by spreading that update so everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I’ll help spread the update about Sunday at the community center. What else still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday at 10 sounds good to me—send the details along and I’ll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send the details and a quick invite to everyone, and I’ll see you Saturday at 10.
